cost: provider-reported input tokens multiplied by the frozen model's execution-date input price
provider-reported output tokens multiplied by the frozen model's execution-date output price
cached-token and batch discounts recorded separately when applicable
accounting_contract.latency: Record monotonic wall time per attempted request and end-to-end per query; report failed and successful attempts separately.
accounting_contract.retries: Record every attempt, reason, delay, provider status, and terminal outcome. Failed attempts still count toward tokens, cost, latency, retry rate, and error rate when billable or measurable.
accounting_contract.tokens: Preserve provider usage fields exactly and aggregate input, output, cached, reasoning, and total tokens separately when exposed.

exact_cost_status.reason: Provider, exact model/version, tokenizer, actual prompt, batching, and price snapshot are unresolved. Choosing a price or tokenizer now would silently choose an architecture.
exact_cost_status.required_before_execution: Freeze provider/model and preserve its authoritative price snapshot; then calculate the preregistered estimate without benchmark-sensitive changes.

failure_policy.rate_limit_handling: bounded retry policy must be frozen before execution; exhaustion is a recorded failure
failure_policy.secret_policy: Read secrets only from environment/provider credential store; never serialize them in requests, raw-response files, logs, manifests, errors, or Git.
failure_policy.unexpected_context_overflow: failure; no silent truncation or candidate dropping

assumptions.purpose: Capacity planning only; not an execution or pricing estimate.

preserve: exact request body after credential exclusion
HTTP status and provider error body
redact: security-sensitive provider request identifiers if policy requires

repeatability_audit.comparison: Compare exact parsed score/rank outputs, raw response hashes, failure state, token usage, and latency for structurally selected trace queries across the frozen repetition count.
repeatability_audit.known_limit: A provider may change hosted model behavior despite a stable model name; exact model version and response fingerprints must be recorded where available.
